topic: Cristiano Ronaldo — a career in five moments (collage tribute)
music: epic emotional cinematic orchestral, soaring strings and triumphant drums, nostalgic then triumphant, building to a climax, no vocals

beats.narration: In 2004, a boy of nineteen wept before a nation. The dream was over. The legend had not yet begun.
beats.motion: one slow push-in on the crying young footballer; aged newspaper edges and halftone dots drift softly; somber and still

beats.narration: By 2008, he ruled the continent — his first Ballon d'Or, and the whole world at his feet.
beats.motion: one slow push-in on the roaring player; the golden trophy gleams; halftone dots pulse gently

beats.narration: In Madrid he became immortal — Champions League after Champions League. La Duodécima.
beats.motion: one slow rise from the player's outstretched arms up to the stacked trophies; paper cut-outs drift lightly

beats.narration: Then the impossible — an overhead strike that turned a rival stadium into applause.
beats.motion: one slow zoom into the bicycle-kick silhouette as the orange starburst radiates; halftone dots pulse

beats.narration: And in 2016, he lifted a continent. Portugal, champions of Europe. Cristiano, forever.
beats.motion: one slow push-in as the player lifts the trophy; gold confetti drifts down; red-and-green ribbons flutter softly
